# Vojislav Miloradovic - Machine-Readable Credentials Archive

> **Last Generated:** 2026-08-10 00:47 UTC
> Curated, structured, and token-optimized record of professional certifications, badges, and learning achievements across Microsoft Learn, AWS, Google Cloud, Credly, LinkedIn, and Google Developer.

- **Microsoft Learn**: 35,608 completed units | 4,804 total achievements | 5,991,750 XP
- **Google Cloud Skills**: 343 badges
- **AWS Skill Builder**: 556 completed courses/activities
- **Credly**: 522 credentials
- **LinkedIn**: 1,337 verified external certifications
- **Google Developer**: 171 milestone badges | 1,457 codelabs & activities
